mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of trading days when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in CPIAUCSL above 0.3% signals rising inflation that may prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL monthly change exceeds 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) and strong industrial production (INDPRO > 100) indicates robust economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both UNRATE < 4.5% and INDPRO > 100.

mechanism_narrative: In tight labor market regimes (UNRATE < 4.5%), the S&P 500 exhibits positive forward returns as companies pass on higher labor costs to consumers, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of trading days when UNRATE is below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 0.5% signals robust manufacturing activity that boosts corporate earnings expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO monthly change exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly residential construction permits level below 1100 thousand units signals a cooling housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is below 1100.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over three months signals a tightening labor market that may lead to wage inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE declines by more than 0.5% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: In strong consumer demand regimes (RSAFS > 450,000 million dollars), the S&P 500 exhibits positive forward returns as companies benefit from robust sales, leading to higher equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of trading days when RSAFS exceeds 450,000.
